top_signals.title: Bessent Stops Short of New Bond Measures Amid Report on Cash Use
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent refrained from any further signals on revamping US debt management on Monday, following a report that his department could draw down some of its cash pile to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Mexico ‘Optimistic’ on US Trade Deal After Canada Talks Fail
top_signals.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum expressed optimism she can reach a trade deal with Donald Trump as her chief negotiator leads talks in Washington, just after negotiations between the US and Canada collapsed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Crypto exchange volumes double in five days as market activity rebounds
top_signals.summary: Monthly volume tells a similar story, with $490 billion traded so far in August compared to $670 billion in July.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
